relations: The established fire fed by dry branches and embers produces a constantly flickering flame plume against the dark trees.
As the flame tongues rise and deform, their pulsing glow casts wavering light on the fixed branch pile and grass.
Combustion generates a faint smoke plume that drifts upward, thinning as it ascends into the canopy.
The bright yellow-white base holds a roughly steady position and intensity while the upper flames shift shape.
caption: The video captures a bonfire burning at dusk on a grassy clearing bordered by dark, leafy trees. The flames rise from a bed of glowing embers, fed by a teepee-like arrangement of dry branches and twigs, with a larger loose pile of cut branches stacked to the right. The fire is already well established and continues to burn steadily throughout. The flame plume constantly flickers, shifting between short, broad shapes and tall, narrow tips that lean and split against the dark backdrop. The bright yellow-white base holds a roughly steady position and intensity while the orange-red tongues above it rise and deform frame by frame. A faint dark smoke plume drifts upward, thinning as it ascends into the trees. The branch structure and surrounding grass remain fixed, with only the lighting on them wavering as the fire's glow pulses.
